_meta.purpose: Prerequisite master data that must exist in D365 F&O before the project contract is posted. Validate with GET before POSTing; create only what is missing.

legalEntity.Name: Daypop Technology Projects LLC
legalEntity._verify: Confirm the actual DataAreaId for the Daypop legal entity.

customer._note: G42 Sky1 sits inside the G42 Holding group. Confirm whether this is an intercompany customer group and whether elimination flags are required.

paymentTerms.Name: N060
paymentTerms._note: Engagement Letter: payment within 60 days from invoice receipt. Late-payment interest not specified; UAE statutory default may apply.

salesTax._note: VAT is excluded from the IFRS 15 transaction price (IFRS 15.47 - collected on behalf of the tax authority). Liquidated damages are non-VAT items and require a separate non-VAT credit document.

projectGroup._note: Fixed-price project group configured for percentage-of-completion revenue recognition. The IFRS 15 measure of progress is an OUTPUT method (milestone completion), so the completion percentage must be driven by accepted milestone value, not cost-to-cost. See 06_revenue_recognition.json.

wipAndRevenueLedgerAccounts._verify: Map to the actual chart of accounts before go-live.

performanceBondTracking.DeadlineBasis: Within 20 days of Engagement Letter signature (19 Sep 2023)
performanceBondTracking._note: Off-balance-sheet contingent exposure for Daypop. No formal retention applies; the bond is the performance security.
